hooks.text: An explosion two billion light-years away physically rattled Earth's atmosphere.
A single cosmic flash temporarily blinded nearly every space telescope.
Seventy times brighter than any previous record, the BOAT blinded space telescopes.

title: The Brightest Cosmic Explosion Ever Recorded
description: Discover GRB 221009A, the brightest gamma-ray burst in cosmic history, which shook Earth's upper atmosphere from two billion light-years away.

beats.text: An explosion two billion light-years away physically rattled Earth's upper atmosphere.
beats.visual: artist's concept of a massive star collapse and black hole formation

beats.text: On October 9, 2022, a massive star located within the constellation Sagitta violently collapsed directly into a black hole.
beats.visual: starfield image of the constellation Sagitta, 2022

beats.text: The resulting gamma-ray burst was officially dubbed the BOAT, standing for Brightest Of All Time.
beats.visual: Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope illustration, NASA
queries: Fermi Gamma ray Space Telescope illustration

beats.text: It completely smashed previous space records by being roughly seventy times brighter than any prior recorded burst.
beats.visual: Swift Gamma-Ray Burst Explorer satellite illustration, NASA
queries: Swift Gamma Ray Burst Explorer satellite

beats.text: The blinding flash was so intensely powerful that it temporarily saturated most gamma-ray space telescope detectors.
beats.visual: James Webb Space Telescope model in space, NASA

beats.text: Specialized lightning detectors across India and Germany picked up signals showing that the blast heavily ionized our upper atmosphere.
beats.visual: Earth upper atmosphere glow and ionosphere, NASA

beats.text: An explosion two billion light-years away shook Earth because its raw cosmic power was completely unmatched.
queries: Massive star collapse black hole illustration
